query:
SELECT id as "id!: i32", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
campaign_id as "campaign_id!: i32", 
not_interested_on as "not_interested_on!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
attempted_on as "attempted_on!: Option < UtcDateTime >" FROM campaign_preferences WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::int4) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as int4[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR account_id = $6::varchar) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR campaign_id = $8::int4) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR not_interested_on = $10::timestamptz) AND ($11::boolean IS NULL OR (($11::boolean AND not_interested_on IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $11::boolean AND not_interested_on IS NULL))) AND (NOT $12::boolean OR attempted_on = $13::timestamptz) AND ($14::boolean IS NULL OR (($14::boolean AND attempted_on IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $14::boolean AND attempted_on IS NULL))) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($15 = 'Id' AND NOT $16) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($15 = 'Id' AND $16) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($15 = 'AccountId' AND NOT $16) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($15 = 'AccountId' AND $16) WHEN true THEN account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($15 = 'CampaignId' AND NOT $16) WHEN true THEN campaign_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($15 = 'CampaignId' AND $16) WHEN true THEN campaign_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($15 = 'NotInterestedOn' AND NOT $16) WHEN true THEN not_interested_on ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($15 = 'NotInterestedOn' AND $16) WHEN true THEN not_interested_on ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($15 = 'AttemptedOn' AND NOT $16) WHEN true THEN attempted_on ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($15 = 'AttemptedOn' AND $16) WHEN true THEN attempted_on ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $17 OFFSET $18
